caption: The drawing consists of three detailed illustrations of an ornamental object, all rendered in shades of blue on a beige background. The largest depiction is in the center and shows the front or side view of the object, which has a symmetrical, intricate design with scroll-like curves, a textured surface, and a central vertical element surrounded by decorative patterns. In the top right corner, within a blue outlined box labeled "END," there is a simplified view emphasizing the curling scroll motifs and additional patterns. In the lower left corner, another blue outlined box labeled "BOTTOM" presents a view of the object's underside featuring parallel lines, geometric shapes, and radiating patterns. The overall composition is clean, with all elements contained within a larger blue rectangular border, and the artist's name, Lorenz Rothkranz, appears in small text at the bottom right corner of the border.
title: Salt Cellar
